hotspots.title: Backlash mounts over executive order renaming Lake Ontario
hotspots.blurb: President Trump's executive order renaming Lake Ontario to 'Lake America' continues to trigger strong pushback from Canadian officials, Indigenous leaders, and lawmakers. The decision has sparked calls for boycotts, legal challenges, and critical commentary from political figures amidst ongoing trade tensions.
hotspots.affect: The topic generates intense affective engagement by combining nationalist symbolism with diplomatic friction, drawing sharp reactions across political and international lines.

hotspots.title: Trump claims historic deal taking control of Venezuelan oil
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration's announced agreement to secure majority control over Venezuelan oil reserves remains a central focus in media coverage. Observers and political factions debate the economic and geopolitical implications, with supporters hailing it as an energy breakthrough and critics citing sovereign overreach.
hotspots.affect: High affective charge stems from opposing narratives of strategic foreign policy triumph versus allegations of imperialist intervention.

hotspots.title: Outrage grows over aggressive immigration enforcement and deportations
hotspots.blurb: Federal immigration operations under the Trump administration have drawn heightened attention following public ICE actions at transit hubs, deportations of military-linked Afghans to third countries, and legal challenges over state tuition rules. The White House's sharing of a controversial cartoon depicting deportees further magnified criticism.
hotspots.affect: Coverage is heavily emotionally charged around themes of humanitarian rights, federal authority, and public messaging disputes.

hotspots.title: PGA Tour names Donald Trump honorary chairman for Presidents Cup
hotspots.blurb: The PGA Tour selected President Donald Trump as the honorary chairman for the 2026 Presidents Cup tournament at Medinah Country Club near Chicago. Trump accepted the role and plans to attend the event, marking his second time serving as honorary chair.
hotspots.affect: The story commands attention by highlighting presidential involvement in major sports, driving positive framing among supporters and widespread media pickup.

hotspots.title: Sweden Democrats face renewed debate over democratic inclusion and legacy
hotspots.blurb: Coverage involving the Sweden Democrats highlights local political disputes, such as exclusion from public digital forums in Bollebygd, alongside party leader Jimmie Åkesson's high-profile church forum appearance. Retrospectives also examine the party's broader integration into mainstream Swedish political discourse.
hotspots.affect: The narrative engages political emotion around democratic representation, free expression, and the normalization of populist parties.
